prompts:
Use case: illustration-story / adaptation of supplied game art into full-color sequential manga. Produce ONE beautiful LANDSCAPE 16:9 COLOR COMIC PAGE, 5 panels, left-to-right then top-to-bottom, varied panel sizes, thin off-white gutters, precise energetic hand-inked linework, mature manga faces, nuanced expressive acting, rich colored cel shading, detailed fantasy architecture with strong depth. NOT photoreal, NOT game UI, NOT character cards. Large clear Traditional Chinese horizontal dialogue in integrated white balloons, tails accurately directed to speakers; small caption boxes only where specified; do not cover faces. No English, watermark or invented subtitles. CONTEMPORARY era of this fantasy world BEFORE the peace breaks, not Earth modernity: no cars/guns/screens/neon/modern buildings. The peoples ALREADY have longstanding civilizations, states/institutions, magnificent architecture, organized emissaries and military equipment. This is NOT the rustic trio, not founders, not primitive tribes. Do NOT show the earlier ordinary blue-shirt carpenter/greencloak porter/purple-robed young civilian mage, do NOT imply they lived into this era. Adapt existing supplied visuals faithfully, not new generic designs. Preserve source faction design: Kingdom polished steel plate with gold trim, deep blue cloth and star motifs, blue gold kite shields, closed angular knight helmets, halberds and swords; Silverleaf disciplined escorts with green cloaks, ivory/gold leaf armor, pointed ears, nature-shaped bows carried lowered, forested graceful architecture; Shadowfolk living people with pale complexions, white hair, purple accents and dark silver engraved armor, purple hooded capes and sheathed curved blades, formal arcane stonework. NOT evil just because dark/purple: no skeleton armies, corpses, necromancy, demonfaces, attack poses or spooky ruins. Unknown representatives must remain ordinary delegates, NO crowns or unnamed central hero invented as royalty; no king, prince, princess, chancellor or culprit identity. Show citizens and commerce as part of a big functioning society, not all soldiers/no people. No newly invented alliance/coronation/treaty. Scene is staging of existing world not new confirmed historic event.
INPUT ROLES: the three supplied faction paintings are visual references to transform into this sequential page: Kingdom, Silverleaf, Shadowfolk. Preserve recognizable clothing/weapon silhouettes and architectural languages, while REPLACING battle formations/background hostility with a PEACETIME JOINT CITY arrival scene. Title small but clear 「當代・共同城市」. Five panels: top full-width panoramic establishing panel occupying about 40% height, two middle narrative panels, two bottom narrative panels. Panel1 sweeping eye-level elevated view through large stone arch over an enormous thriving city: several bridges, paved avenues, established white-stone civic buildings, large leafy elegant arcades and trees, dignified dark-violet arcanist domes/stone towers woven into the city, docks and numerous small citizens. Architecture coherent yet cultural distinctions visible, NOT dividing races into segregated walled ghettos. Palace scale visible in distance with NO ruler shown. Caption EXACT 「如今，各族帶著自己的制度、軍隊與傳統，在這座城相遇。」 Panel2 medium wide gate guard desk: ordinary Kingdom gate officer in source steel/blue/gold closed helmet looking toward a large orderly green/ivory Silverleaf envoy procession with escort, seated clerk and pedestrians show institution; officer speech 「銀葉使團到了。」 Panel3 different street angle: Shadowfolk diplomatic party in formal dark purple/silver garments with white-haired living scholars and their hooded armored escorts arrives beneath tall arcane arch; a messenger turns toward gate control and announces 「暮影的使節也已入城。」 Do not turn them into villains or draw hostile glowing eyes. Panel4 close perspective of organized civilian merchants/carts moving beside disciplined Kingdom halberdiers holding weapons upright, road staff guiding traffic, a mounted Kingdom courier heading toward coordination point, bubble from gate sergeant 「通知守軍，維持通道。」 Panel5 larger quiet shot from raised walkway into vast processions and city where green, purple, blue banners remain distinct, soldiers protect passersby rather than intimidate each other. Two anonymous adults in prosperous civic dress speaking in foreground, one asks 「這座城，最後會由誰來統領？」 Other listens silently. No answer, no identified plotter, no simplistic moral narration. Open political question, atmosphere grand, orderly, prosperous with subtle underlying uncertainty.

INPUT ROLES: Image1 original unskinned 雷恩 portrait is the PRIMARY face/costume identity anchor; Image2 four-hero continuity sheet supplies same hero at far LEFT (ignore remaining characters); Image3 Kingdom army supplies soldier uniforms/weapons. Transform the portrait/army into 5 sequential color manga panels of 雷恩 on duty at the SAME prosperous joint city's gate. Preserve 雷恩 exactly: mature angular clean-shaven face, thick brows and brown eyes, short tousled CHESTNUT brown hair, antique gold-edged steel armor, royal-blue cloth, WHITE FUR collar, gold star breastplate, LARGE royal blue and gold kite shield. NOT black hair, beard, elf ears, generic blonde hero or rustic carpenter. Do not name him commander of the entire guard: only show known hero 雷恩 directing nearby Kingdom guards. All unnamed guards have closed blue/steel helmets and source-standard shields/halberds, not fur collars/full hero costume clones. Title 「城門前的秩序」. Layout 2 panels top row, 2 smaller panels middle row, broad dramatic lower panel. Panel1 wide gate-side street level: formal Silverleaf escort and a caravan have reached a narrow gate passage at same time; crowd backed up, no violence, guard in Kingdom gear approaches 雷恩, who is seen three-quarter back with huge blue-gold shield: guard bubble 「雷恩大人，車隊和使團擠在一起了！」 Panel2 expressive close-up 雷恩 looks past guard toward citizens, brown eyes focused, whitefur and bluegoldarmor unchanged: bubble 「先讓行人通過。」 Panel3 medium action 雷恩 extends gloved hand directing nearby guards into lane, shield low on other arm, strong upright protective posture: bubble 「守軍分列兩側，替車隊留出路。」 Panel4 dynamic low shot Kingdom guards move efficiently into positions, shields at side not charging, a guard opens a clear lane with palm out, envoy escorts cooperate while citizens cross, guard balloon 「收到！」 Panel5 wide conclusive view: a now-orderly large procession of green-cloaked Silverleaf escort, farther purple-clad Shadowfolk diplomatic group, merchant carts and families cross monumental city gate in separate streams, full architectural scale and many uniformed guards. 雷恩 foreground threequarter profile watches the operation, still face identifiable, no photo portrait pose. Guard near him says 「通道暢通了。」 雷恩 replies 「守好崗位，別讓人受傷。」 Peace is tangible organized daily work, not war and not new battle. No extra philosophy caption. Exact Traditional Chinese dialogue, large readable font. Uniform and face consistency more important than extra decorative detail.
